MERIDIAN INDUSTRIAL DETAIL PACK — ORIGINAL ASSETS

These 24 models, material definitions, authoring scripts and original inspection
renders were created for Last Vehicle / A GingrSnaps Project from numerical
geometry. They incorporate no downloaded models, photographs or textures.

The original asset contribution is offered under CC0 1.0 Universal:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode

To the extent copyright and related rights exist in this contribution, they are
waived under that dedication. You may edit and redistribute these assets,
including in commercial projects. No attribution is required; retaining this
provenance notice is appreciated.

Blender and Babylon.js are separate software with their own licenses. No part
of those programs is relicensed by this notice. The contact-sheet typography is
an inspection label, not embedded font data inside the game models.
